description: Derived from AGSC-01-03: the `type` key is authoritative and MUST match the containing folder; a mismatch is AGSC-E205. Over the minimal fixture, whose lint reports nothing, one file is added: content/concepts/wrong-folder.md, a lesson that carries every key and body section its type asks for (AGSC-02-21) and is a member of the fixture's cluster, so that nothing but its placement is at fault. AGSC-01-02 puts a lesson under content/lessons/, so the whole list `lint` reports is one AGSC-E205 error naming that file, and lint exits 1. The folder is never taken as the type: the item is not re-typed as a concept, which would raise the concept's own required keys instead.

add_files.content/concepts/wrong-folder.md:
---
type: lesson
title: Wrong folder
description: A lesson that is valid in every key but sits in the concepts folder of the Bundle.
clusters:
  - agent-patterns
severity: info
prov:
  origin: human
  operator: human:tester
---

## Lesson

Place each item in its type's folder.

## Evidence

This file.

## Check before

The folder name.
